title: The fridge check that always passes
hints: Try `{4, 9}` with the range 0 to 8 by hand. How many times does the loop body run before the function returns?
The loop gives its answer after looking at the first reading only: one branch returns false, the other returns true. A "yes" is only safe after every reading has been checked.
Delete the `else { return true; }` branch so the loop keeps going; the `return true;` after the loop already handles the all-good case.
